# entomo

> entomo is the agentic intelligence platform for performance and skills, powering 30M+ users across
> enterprises and governments. entomo.ai is the platform; axon is the intelligence behind it; Enzo is the
> AI co-worker inside it; TMRW is entomo's national talent transformation platform.

Canonical site: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/
Every figure on this site is drawn from entomo's published record for that client.

## platform
- [entomo | Agentic Workforce Intelligence Platform](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/index.html): AI agents that coach every employee, advise every leader, and automate HR workflows, delivering enterprise outcomes at scale. Powering 30M+ users globally.
- [entomo axon | the intelligence behind entomo.ai](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/AI-lab/entomo-axon.html): axon is the intelligence behind entomo.ai: it connects what every role requires with what every person brings, creating the workforce intelligence that powers better performance, development, mobility and succession.
- [enzo | the intelligent co-worker](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/AI-lab/enzo.html): Enzo is the intelligent co-worker inside entomo.ai: twenty-eight AI capabilities across six pillars of the employee journey, every one grounded in axon, entomo's living model of work.
- [From Skills to Employability](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/Home/national-talent-transformation-v2.html): From skills to employability at national scale. TMRW by entomo is the digital infrastructure that operationalises national skills frameworks — connecting skills, learning, credentials, jobs, and mobility into one workforce ecosystem that delivers measurable employment outcomes.
- [dia](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/dia.html): DIA is entomo's data intelligence assistant: ask any workforce question in plain language and get a board-ready recommendation, not a chart. Agent teams analyse across performance, skills, engagement, and wellness signals, grounded in one workforce graph.

## solutions
- [competency framework creation](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/competency-framework-creation.html): Build a living competency framework on entomo axon: AI market intelligence, 4,000+ pre-built roles, proficiency levels with behavioral indicators, and expert-led validation through formal sign-off. 80% less cost and effort than building from scratch.
- [Engagement Intelligence](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/engagement-intelligence.html): Drive continuous employee engagement and culture. Agentic intelligence that listens to your workforce, celebrates contributions, and surfaces engagement signals for leaders, in real time.
- [engagement and retention](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/engagement-retention.html): Keep your best people. entomo's agentic engagement intelligence listens continuously, surfaces sentiment and burnout signals in real time, and activates the interventions that keep people connected: recognition, mentorship, coaching, and visible growth paths, in the flow of work.
- [enterprise performance management office](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/epmo.html): entomo builds your enterprise performance management office: advisory plus platform that aligns every KPI from strategy map to individual scorecard, with agentic AI keeping performance continuous. 30M+ users powered. Forrester-validated: $26.8M value, 103% ROI.
- [Hire to Retire](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/hire-to-retire.html): Simplify the entire employee journey. Agentic intelligence that unifies recruitment, onboarding, payroll, attendance, and exit, one seamless experience for HR and employees.
- [internal mobility](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/internal-mobility.html): Internal mobility on entomo: career paths computed from skill adjacency, opportunities matched to skills and aspirations, development plans that close gaps, and skills-driven succession. Agentic AI surfaces the roles your people are already closest to, before vacancies appear.
- [learning ROI](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/learning-roi.html): Learning curated to the gap, not the catalog. entomo targets learning at assessment-verified skill gaps, generates AI-powered development plans, and verifies the proficiency change, so learning spend traces to capability outcomes. Platform-proven: 30M+ users, Forrester-validated 103% ROI.
- [Performance Intelligence](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/performance-intelligence.html): Close the gap between goals and execution. Agentic intelligence that coaches every employee, equips every manager, and surfaces performance signals for leaders, in real time.
- [Career and Learning Management](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/skill-intelligence.html): Unlock your workforce's full potential. Skills are the new currency of work. Agentic AI that maps, validates, and grows your workforce's capabilities.
- [strategic performance management office](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/spmo.html): entomo helps enterprises build and run a strategic performance management office (SPMO): balanced scorecards, strategy maps, and KPI cascade from corporate strategy to every individual scorecard, with AI agents and advisory keeping the whole performance cycle aligned. Powering 30M+ users.
- [Strategic Workforce Planning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/strategic-planning.html): Strategic workforce planning with agentic AI: project workforce demand and talent supply, surface the gap by role, model the scenarios, and get a build, buy, borrow or bot recommendation for every gap, so your people plan stays ahead of your business plan.
- [succession planning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/succession-planning.html): Succession planning with agentic AI: critical roles risk-scored, successor readiness scored on evidence with skills-match percentages, nine-box calibration, and talent pools in ready-now tiers. entomo turns annual nominations into living leadership pipelines.
- [Wellness Intelligence](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/wellness-intelligence.html): Protect your people's wellbeing. Agentic intelligence that senses wellness signals early, nudges proactively, and protects your workforce before stress becomes attrition.
- [workforce analytics and reporting](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-analytics.html): Agentic workforce analytics and reporting from entomo: ask workforce questions in plain language, get decision-ready answers, ISO 30414-aligned human capital reporting, predictive analytics, and market benchmarks from one governed source of truth.
- [workforce assessments at scale](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-assessments.html): Generate, deliver, and score technical, behavioral, cognitive, conversational, and 360° assessments at workforce scale. entomo turns axon role intelligence into assessment blueprints, verifies proficiency through AI plus human validation, and converts gaps into growth. Deployable in weeks.
- [Workforce Insights](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-insights.html): Turn workforce data into decisions. Every workforce question deserves a real answer, not a dashboard. Agentic AI that interprets your people data and recommends what to do next.
- [workforce planning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-planning.html): Workforce planning with agentic AI: model demand against strategy, rank skill gaps, compare build, buy, borrow, or bot for every need, and score succession on evidence. entomo plan connects your growth ambitions to workforce capability before the need turns urgent.

## research and downloads
- [30 revolutionary ideas for our remote age](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-30-ideas-remote-age.html): thirty ideas from thirty HR and education influencers on what remote work changes permanently.
- [the agentic HR operating model](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-agentic-hr-operating-model.html): what changes when intelligence acts inside the process rather than reporting on it, with a maturity model PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/agentic-hr-operating-model.pdf
- [driving business value: augmenting human capital management with AI](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-augmenting-hcm-with-ai.html): a report on where talent analytics matures, written with ETHRWorld.
- [evolution of career readiness: singapore](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-career-readiness-singapore.html): a study of which roles and skills stayed resilient as the singapore career landscape shifted.
- [governing AI in HR](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-governing-ai-in-hr.html): a readiness guide to the EU AI Act, NYC Local Law 144 and the documentation your HR systems must hold PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/governing-ai-in-hr.pdf
- [leveraging HRTech to create best-in-class talent engagement](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-hrtech-talent-engagement.html): a four-part webinar series on the platforms reshaping digital HR, recorded with IHRP Singapore.
- [human capital disclosure: ISO 30414 and CSRD](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-human-capital-disclosure-iso-30414-csrd.html): a metric-by-metric readiness guide to ISO 30414:2025 and the workforce disclosures inside the revised EU standards PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/human-capital-disclosure-iso-30414-csrd.pdf
- [designing an internal talent marketplace people use](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-internal-talent-marketplace-people-use.html): the operating model, manager incentives and metrics that separate a working marketplace from an empty job board PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/internal-talent-marketplace-people-use.pdf
- [mastering risk and performance in the next normal](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-mastering-risk-and-performance.html): essential practices for enterprises and employees operating across owned, shared and remote workplaces.
- [reform and reimagine workplace practices: a roadmap for leaders](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-reform-reimagine-roadmap.html): part two of the returning-to-work roadmap, a self-check across the react, respond, reform and reimagine stages.
- [are you ready to return to work? a self-assessment for leaders](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-return-to-work-self-assessment.html): part one of the returning-to-work roadmap, built around a yes or no self-check for leadership teams.
- [the skills-based organisation, practically](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-skills-based-organisation-practically.html): a staged first-year guide from role architecture to skills-based staffing, with what to do in each quarter PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/skills-based-organisation-practically.pdf
- [workforce planning when AI changes the work](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-workforce-planning-when-ai-changes-the-work.html): how to model demand and supply when task composition shifts, with a build, buy, borrow, bot matrix PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/workforce-planning-when-ai-changes-the-work.pdf

## writing
- [assessing skills at scale without fooling yourself](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-assessing-skills-at-scale-without-fooling-yourself.html): validity is an argument you build, reliability is the ceiling you cannot exceed, and most internal assessments fail on both.
- [autonomy should be a dial, not a switch](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-autonomy-is-a-dial-not-a-switch.html): a four-level model for governing AI in HR, with what to log at each level and the evidence required to move a use case up.
- [burnout is a job design problem, not a resilience problem](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-burnout-is-a-job-design-problem.html): the evidence points at demands, resources and control, yet most organisations respond by measuring how well people cope with them.
- [career paths people can walk](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-career-paths-people-can-walk.html): career frameworks name destinations and skip the route; paths built from skill distance tell people where they can go next.
- [your engagement survey measures the wrong latency](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-engagement-surveys-measure-the-wrong-latency.html): engagement moves day to day, the annual survey reports once a year, and the gap between those two clocks is where most listening programmes fail.
- [goal quality is measurable, and most goals fail the test](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-goal-quality-is-a-measurable-property.html): a goal nobody can review produces no feedback, and that failure can be scored, sampled and tracked across an entire organisation.
- [internal mobility runs on two clocks](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-internal-mobility-two-clocks.html): one clock fills the role open this month, the other builds the career that takes three years, and most organisations wind only one of them.
- [the job description is the wrong unit of analysis](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-job-description-wrong-unit-of-analysis.html): job titles average away the variation that matters, and the decisions enterprises now face need a smaller unit than the job.
- [learning spend needs a chain of evidence](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-learning-roi-chain-of-evidence.html): training evaluation stops at satisfaction scores because the next four links are unowned, not because they are impossible.
- [your skills taxonomy is a dictionary, not a diagnosis](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-skills-taxonomy-dictionary-not-diagnosis.html): a taxonomy resolves what to call things, and cannot tell you proficiency, context or currency, which is where every workforce decision lives.
- [succession slates need evidence, not ratings](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-succession-readiness-is-evidence.html): nine-box grids produce agreement quickly and accuracy rarely, and a board question will find the difference every time.
- [the workforce report your board and your auditor both accept](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-the-board-ready-workforce-report.html): ISO 30414 became a requirements standard in 2025 and the EU narrowed CSRD in 2026, which changes what a credible disclosure set looks like.
- [the queue between a question and its answer](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-the-queue-between-question-and-answer.html): self-service analytics never removed the wait for workforce answers, because the slow part was never retrieval.
- [why competency frameworks die in month seven](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-why-competency-frameworks-die-in-month-seven.html): role requirements drift faster than any rewrite cycle; a framework survives only if it is maintained monthly like an operating system.
- [workforce planning is a decision, not a spreadsheet](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-workforce-planning-is-a-decision-not-a-spreadsheet.html): build, buy, borrow or bot: every capability needs a supply decision on the record, with the evidence that would reverse it.
